fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-03-27, around 08:40, a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 18,500 was withdrawn, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-03-27. Naveen Natarajan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000057. Praveen Sekar (9000000221), described as a relative of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100069. Yuvaraj Palanisamy (9000000158) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint mentions Vignesh Subramani, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000487, in connection with the events. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference and mobile phone records. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00023, as the mobile number 9000000487 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Bank transaction reference; Mobile phone record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim was allegedly induced to approve a collect request on a UPI app.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, bank reference, morning, receiving account, phone records, associate, witness
